decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
1 /The trailer advertisement sign,  would , by reason of  its  position and appearance in relation to the M4 Motorway, is  a potential road safety hazard to the free flow of traffic and is contrary to the Policies  ENVB 1.1, (New Development), ENVB 1.4 (Advertisements)  and T4.4 (Road Safety)  of the Unitary Development Plan.

2/  The trailer advertisement sign is, by reason of its size, position and appearance, an  intrusive  feature in an area of Metropolitan Land and Special Advertisement Control which is  to the detriment of the visual amenity of the local area.    The proposal is contrary to the policy ENVB 1.4 (Advertisements),  ENVN 1.5 (Protection of MOL), ENVN 1.6 (Metropolitan Open Land Acceptable Uses), ENVN 1.9  (Metropolitan Open Land Improvements), ENVN 1.15 (Heritage Land) and ENVN 1.16 (Historic Parks and Gardens)  of the  Unitary Development Plan
description: Retention of trailer sign (6.5m x 3.07m) to existing grounds of park.
